The '''Empartheca system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Prengahl Kreen]], a third-generation [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], was one of the most successful [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]] there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Empartheca [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square O-18.<ref name="TEA" />
